changes.title: Needle drop
items: After the party spell the witch drops the needle and does a little scratching routine at her decks (baby scratches, chirps and a spin-back) before she can step off and the music drops
Knocked out and back behind her decks, she scratches through the wait, her hand thrown up as it ends

changes.title: Dark legend light
items: Dark-coated legends (the bear, the boar, the raven and others as dark) no longer vanish into the night

changes.title: Area ambience
items: Every area has its own quiet soundscape: wind gusting down the ravine, frogs and drips in the marshes, old oaks creaking, a low hum among the standing stones, drips in the cave mouth
It stays soft by the party and comes up out in the wild
